question.text: Which statement best reflects PMS marketing and disclosure rules?

answer.text: Marketing performance must match SEBI-reported performance and carry a "not verified by SEBI" disclaimer; disclosure document must state no assurance/guarantee and that past performance is not indicative of future performance

explanation.text: The Logic: Marketing material must use performance figures matching the performance reported to SEBI and must include a disclaimer that the performance information is not verified by SEBI. The disclosure document must state that there is no assurance or guarantee, and that past performance does not indicate future performance. The Trap: "Advertise freely", English-only, or print-only are not the cited rules; the substantive requirements are about performance accuracy and disclaimers. Note: The marketing-performance rule and the disclosure-document language come from the cited source pages.
